verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents n8n's visual/code-hybrid workflow builder, AI agent nodes, MCP integration, and model connectivity, but nothing describes an n8n feature where a user types a natural-language prompt and n8n generates or edits the workflow definition itself. n8n-docs-26 references a workflow use-case that converts NL into API calls, but that is a workflow's runtime behavior, not n8n's own workflow-authoring UX. Since AI-native NL-to-workflow generation is a plausible and increasingly common capability for automation platforms, the axis applies, but no supporting evidence is present.
